# Phase 01.1 Plan 07: Net-New Primitives Summary

**Seven `radix-nova` registry primitives vendored as reviewed source with zero dependency or stylesheet movement, plus hand-authored `Icon` and `Tag`, all nine brought onto the Cena language at a 44px floor whose arithmetic is now measured rather than assumed.**

## Performance

- **Duration:** 26 min
- **Tasks:** 3
- **Files:** 10 (9 created, 1 modified)

## Accomplishments

- **The net-new half of SC2's primitive inventory is closed.** Nine primitives exist that did not before, every one carrying the Cena visual language on top of unmodified Radix behaviour.
- **Zero dependencies and zero stylesheet movement, asserted rather than claimed.** `git diff --stat` over `package.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml` and `app/globals.css` between the base commit and HEAD prints nothing.
- **`label.tsx` survived provably.** Its sha256 is byte-identical before and after the CLI run, so the `.design-sync/NOTES.md` `peer-disabled:` workaround was not silently reverted.
- **A real accessibility defect was found in the file everything else copies.** `checkbox.tsx`'s hit expander reaches 40x32px, not 44px — under the floor, in the reference implementation. The corrected 14px inset was used from the start here and the extended gate now measures the arithmetic, so 01.1-08 inherits a test that will name the defect rather than a convention it might repeat.
- **The touch-floor gate grew a second mechanism without a rewrite,** exactly as 01.1-05 designed it to: 8 hit-area cases across 5 primitive files, every dimension parsed from source.

## Task Commits

1. **Task 1: Add the seven registry primitives and prove label.tsx survived** — `1608025` (feat)
2. **Task 2: Re-skin the seven to the Cena language at the 44px floor** — `9d15c4e` (feat)
3. **Task 3: Hand-author Icon and Tag** — `f3021e9` (feat)

## Tripwire Failure Evidence

The extended gate was observed failing before being accepted. `RadioGroupItem`'s inset was temporarily reverted to the one `checkbox.tsx` actually ships:

> `SC3 VIOLATION — RadioGroupItem (components/ui/radio-group.tsx) has a hit area 32px tall, below the 44px floor.`
> `  painted box: 16px`
> `  expander:    8px per side`
> `  classes:     "… after:-inset-x-3 after:-inset-y-2 …"`
> …*"reaching 44 from a 16px box takes 14px per side, `after:-inset-3.5`"*

It named the primitive, the file, the measured height, **decomposed it into painted box and expander**, and prescribed the fix. `git diff` confirms the probe was reverted.

Two further false-positive classes were found and closed while building it, both of which would have made the gate lie:

1. `group-data-horizontal/tabs:after:h-0.5` — the **active-tab underline** (2px) read as the trigger's box.
2. `[&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4` — the **icon glyph** (16px) read as the control box.

Both are the same trap `boxUnits` documents for Button, met again because these class strings carry far more pseudo-element and child-selector geometry. The parser now accepts only unprefixed utilities for the painted box, and brace-matches the `className` expression so `SelectTrigger`'s nested chevron cannot leak in.

## Decisions Made

1. **`checkbox.tsx`'s expander is wrong, and the new controls do not copy it.** `after:-inset-x-3 after:-inset-y-2` on a `size-4` box is 40x32px. Reaching 44 needs 14px per side. `checkbox.tsx` is owned by 01.1-08 and was not touched here; the gate is written so 01.1-08 gets a red with the arithmetic spelled out.
2. **`switch` takes a different vertical inset per size.** A single blanket 14px leaves `sm` (14px track) at 42px — 2px short. `sm` takes 16px vertically instead. This is the kind of near-miss a blanket inset hides, which is why the gate resolves each size separately.
3. **`RadioGroup` raises its pitch for bare items.** Two bare items at `gap-2` with 14px expanders have hit areas that **overlap by 20px** — pressing one radio sets the other, which is worse than a small target because it looks like it worked. Direct-child items get `gap-7`, making the pitch exactly 16 + 28 = 44px so hit areas tile edge to edge. Items nested in `Field` rows keep `gap-2`, because there the row is the control and already carries `min-h-11`.
4. **`tabs` takes the accent as ink and underline, never as a fill.** UI-SPEC reserves azure for "the active or selected nav item" — which an active tab is — but also caps it at once per view as the primary action. An accent-filled tab would compete with the screen's real CTA.
5. **`separator` drops the client-boundary directive, and this was proven rather than assumed.** The flat `radix-ui` bundle carries no directive of its own, so the claim needed evidence: `Separator` was temporarily imported and rendered in `app/(dashboard)/venues/page.tsx` (a Server Component) and `pnpm build` exited 0. Probe reverted.
6. **`select` is added but deliberately not adopted on the venue form,** recorded in its header with all three reasons (OS picker is better one-handed; a listbox has no `.options` for `venue-form-languages.test.tsx` to read; native inherits platform assistive-technology handling).
7. **`field.tsx` and `components/field-error.tsx` are reconciled, not merged.** They export the same name and take different shapes — `messages?: string[]` (this repo's Zod + `useActionState` output) versus `errors?: Array<{message?: string}>` (react-hook-form). `field-error.tsx` keeps ownership of message rendering; `Field` is adopted for layout. The header records which to alias when a file needs both.
8. **Measured tokens replaced opacity approximations** in two places, following the tracer's precedent: `bg-[var(--cena-accent-soft)]` for the selected field card rather than `bg-primary/5`, and `text-muted-foreground` for idle tabs rather than `text-foreground/60`. Neither opacity value appears in any contrast sweep row.

## Deviations from Plan

### Auto-fixed Issues

**1. [Rule 1 — Bug] Three contract comments reproduced the exact literals their own acceptance greps forbid**

- **Found during:** Task 2, running the acceptance criteria
- **Issue:** `grep -c '"use client"' components/ui/separator.tsx` returned **1** and `grep -c 'data-[state=' ` returned **1** for both `switch.tsx` and `radio-group.tsx` — all three from *comments explaining why the banned form is absent*. The code was correct; the documentation broke the check that proves the code is correct.
- **Fix:** Reworded all three to describe the banned form rather than quote it, each noting inline why it is not spelled out — so the next author does not "helpfully" re-add the example.
- **Files modified:** `components/ui/separator.tsx`, `components/ui/switch.tsx`, `components/ui/radio-group.tsx`
- **Verification:** All three greps now return 0.
- **Committed in:** `9d15c4e`
- **Note:** This is the same failure mode as plan 01.1-05's deviation 4 (its `layout.tsx` comment tripped the source scan by writing out a CDN URL). It is now recorded as a `patterns` entry, since it has cost two plans.

**2. [Rule 2 — Missing Critical] `select.tsx` would have been an orphaned lucide call site**

- **Found during:** Task 3, enumerating the migration for `icon.tsx`'s header
- **Issue:** The plan assigns the four primitive glyph call sites to 01.1-08 and the fourteen surfaces to 01.1-09..12. But 01.1-08's scope is the **ten pre-existing** primitives, and `select.tsx` — created by *this* plan and importing three lucide glyphs — is not among them. No plan owned it, and 01.1-14's discipline test would have gone red on a file with no owner.
- **Fix:** Migrated `select.tsx`'s three glyphs onto `Icon` in this plan, which owns the file, and recorded the ownership split explicitly in `icon.tsx`'s header. The migration is a **nineteen**-file job, not eighteen, because this plan added a nineteenth.
- **Files modified:** `components/ui/select.tsx`
- **Verification:** `pnpm build` exit 0 (including the `SelectPrimitive.Icon asChild` composition); suite green.
- **Committed in:** `f3021e9`

**3. [Rule 2 — Missing Critical] Overlapping hit areas on adjacent bare radios**

- **Found during:** Task 2, applying the 14px expander
- **Issue:** The plan specifies the expander inset but not the spacing it implies. At the registry's `gap-2`, two adjacent radio items' 44px hit areas overlap by 20px — a press near the boundary sets the wrong radio. A correctly-sized target that selects the wrong value is a worse defect than an undersized one.
- **Fix:** `has-[>[data-slot=radio-group-item]]:gap-7` on the group root — a 44px pitch for bare items only, leaving the composed `Field`-row case at `gap-2`.
- **Files modified:** `components/ui/radio-group.tsx`
- **Verification:** Arithmetic recorded in-file; suite green.
- **Committed in:** `9d15c4e`

**4. [Rule 2 — Missing Critical] Type roles and a body-copy accent link in `field.tsx`**

- **Found during:** Task 2
- **Issue:** The registry file shipped `font-medium` (weight 500 — the third weight UI-SPEC forbids and the tracer retired), `text-sm`/`text-base`/`text-xs` (none of which is one of the four permitted roles), and `[&>a:hover]:text-primary` — an accent on a link in body copy, which UI-SPEC lists explicitly among the things azure is **not** for.
- **Fix:** Collapsed to the four roles across `field.tsx`, `tabs.tsx`, `select.tsx` and `tooltip.tsx`; the description link now deepens to `text-foreground` on hover, with the underline carrying the affordance.
- **Files modified:** the four above
- **Verification:** Suite green; build clean.
- **Committed in:** `9d15c4e`

### Deliberate Interpretation

**`icon.tsx` "under 30 lines".** The acceptance criteria require the file to be under 30 lines *and* to carry a header naming which plan owns which call site. Those cannot both hold literally. Resolved toward the plan's own wording — "keep it to roughly fifteen lines" describes the wrapper — so the **component is 18 non-comment lines** and the required ownership ledger sits above it, bringing the file to 51 lines total. Surfaced rather than silently choosing one.
